description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. Regarding women's ordination, shouldn't local Seventh-day Adventist churches obey the official policy of the worldwide Seventh-day Adventist church?
2. Should tithe be returned/paid that comes from a financial aide, from school, disability or unemployment benefits, or loans?
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
